pages.text: Returns the natural logarithm of a number.$(br2)The number must be greater than 0, otherwise INVALID_ARGUMENT is raised.
$(li)$(1)value$() INTEGER|FLOAT: the number, greater than 0$(li)result $(1)result$() FLOAT: the natural logarithm
$(1)CALL c0de/math/LOG$(br)  PARAMETER value amount ;$(br)  RESULT result logarithm$()
